eLauncher

Current build of eLauncher from master. eLauncher is an extremely lightweight and minimal launcher for Android, tailored for eInk devices.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://thypon.github.io/eLauncher/fdroid/repo
